_comment: Codex hooks for Nodge commit-context capture. Installed automatically with the Codex plugin (referenced from .codex-plugin/plugin.json — CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is set by Codex for compatibility). Manual alternative without the plugin: copy this into ~/.codex/hooks.json and replace the variable with the absolute path to the unzipped folder. Codex only exposes a hard Stop hook for this purpose (its planner tool is not hook-interceptable), so Codex records end-of-turn summaries; plan/progress capture is Claude-Code-only. Run the nodge-connect skill (or node scripts/connect.mjs) once so the script has credentials.
